            col = grid[r][c]; end = r + 1
            while end < h and grid[end][c] == col: end += 1
            if col != bg and end - r >= 2: bars.append(('v', c, r, end, col))
            r = end
    pairs = []
    for orient, far_edge in (('h', h - 1), ('v', w - 1)):
        group = [b for b in bars if b[0] == orient]
        a = next((b for b in group if b[1] == 0), None)
        z = next((b for b in group if b[1] == far_edge), None)
